title: The residually weakly primitive geometries of the Dihedral Groups

exact_primary_anchor.statement: Theorem 4, printed pp.9–10, explicitly cites L109 as reference [20] and reproduces all three dihedral families, automatic F/RC/FT, and the complete binomial class count at every rank 2 through omega(n)+1 for n>2.
exact_primary_anchor.definition: Section 1: existential maximal-subgroup RWPRI condition; no local two-transitivity imposed

additional_anchor.statement: Theorem 5.1, printed pp.51–52, reproduces the rank-two theorem, including the Klein-four exception
